# Examina

> Examina is an AI tutor for CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 board exam preparation, based on the NCERT textbooks. It teaches chapters on a live whiteboard with a spoken walkthrough, lets students ask doubts mid-lesson, gives adaptive MCQ practice, diagnoses wrong answers, and marks written answers against step-wise board marking schemes.

Examina is an independent study tool and is not affiliated with CBSE or NCERT. Students should confirm the current syllabus and exam pattern on the official CBSE website.

## Coverage
- Class 10: Maths, Science
- Class 12: Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology
